source.title: Nowcast of Employment by Region and Occupation, ANZSCO 4 Digit Occupations and SA4 Regions, August 2026

observation.retrieval_method: HTTPS GET from the archive URL on the official publisher host
observation.retention_reason: The 48 MB archive and 372 MB uncompressed CSV are not required for repository review. Re-acquisition from the registered source is reproducible, but the archive must be acquired again for a fresh computation.

reproduction.explanation: The generated file differs only in the local temporary archive filename, release-availability explanation and JSON key order. After removing those non-derived metadata fields, deep structural comparison matched every remaining field and all 440 series.

assurance.statement: HTTPS retrieval from the registered official host, a matching archive digest and a deep-equal rebuild provide source continuity and deterministic extraction evidence. They do not provide a publisher signature or an independent witness to the bytes.

disposition.maximum_claim: A temporary retrieval from the registered official URL produced a bit-for-bit match to the archive captured earlier on 2026-09-08, and the frozen recipe reproduced all 440 derived series after excluding two declared non-derived metadata fields. This does not authenticate publisher origin independently, establish prospective availability, validate NERO as direct observation, establish any condition as true, or authorise decision use.
